intent: B5 of the final-release programme: the dashboard becomes an operations board and Insights the history page. CommandCenter cut to a Progress line; the Rec Room panel and LiveClock removed; six pills from real reads; the hero tiles, throughput, mix, run activity and trophy case live on Insights only. A failing /api/monitor renders an error with Retry, never skeletons forever, never a green pill on an unread panel; the first-run panel stable against partial facts (D54, D57). The fourth first-run step, a model the agent can call (D110). The Insights range switch drives every tile, one money number, Retry retries every query (D96, D97, D100).

reasons.evidence: two pages rebuilt; no route, schema or public contract changed

programme: B5, depends on B3 (T-0097) and B4 (T-0098). Dashboard render test with a rejecting fetch; first-run-steps tests; Insights tests; screenshots recaptured.
invariants: I1 The dashboard answers what is happening now and nothing else: six pills (Gateway, Memory, Scheduler, Spend, Processes, Errors), each a link to the surface that answers in full, one Progress line, the dispatch strip and the live panels. No clock, no Rec Room card, no Command Center; the charts, the mission mix and the trophy case are on Insights and nowhere else.

I2 Nothing on the board is green until it has been read. A subsystem row that has not answered reads Checking, a check that failed reads Unknown, and a pill never says Healthy from a panel nobody has read. The words are the ratified ones (decision 13), and the Subsystems panel beside the pills says them too, so one screen never says ok and Healthy about the same gateway.

I3 Not yet and failed are different answers. useDashboard exposes the monitor and subsystems queries' error and settled state; a monitor that has not answered shows skeletons, a monitor that failed shows an alert with a Retry that re-reads it, and the first-run checklist waits for both reads before it speaks.

I4 A gateway this install has seen reachable stays reachable for the checklist through a single failed probe, with its address kept; nothing else is latched (counts, the framework and the model follow the newest reading).

I5 The checklist has four steps in the order agent, model, mission, sessions; the model step points at /agent/models and is done only when config.yaml's default or the registry's agent slot names a model.

I6 On Insights the Active days tile reads the window's bundle, so its number follows the switch its label names; the spend panel is the one money number on the page and the model list carries no dollar figure; Retry retries every query the page reads, the timeseries included; the mission mix has a card beside the trend and the heatmap.
commits: c5ff7dab the oracle alone (4 suites, 81 tests, measured red: 70 failing, 11 green controls); 752a4c2c the implementation (the page, the Progress line, the hook's four fields, the model step and the latch, the bundle's activeDays, Insights, the walkthrough, the Command Center and two barrel re-exports deleted); bee930f9 the Subsystems panel on the ratified words and the three oracles the sweep asked for.
deviation: (1) The Subsystems panel's state words moved to the ratified vocabulary in this batch though the plan listed only the pills: the walk showed ok, ok, ok in the row beside pills saying Healthy about the same gateway, which is the two-vocabularies finding the review named, and the map already existed. The monitor-failure oracle was narrowed to pills (a div, not the panel's span) because the panel beside them was read and may say Healthy. (2) The Progress line takes its facts as props from the page (the stats poll, the agents by growth, the same 30s clock the scheduler pill uses) rather than fetching for itself as the Command Center did, so the page has one stats read and the line is testable without hooks. (3) The gateway latch is state settled during render (React's documented previous-render pattern) rather than a ref, because the lint rule against reading refs in render is right about it. (4) A monitor that failed AFTER a successful read keeps showing the last-good pills (TanStack keeps last data); the alert replaces the pills only when there is nothing to show. (5) The Errors pill counts the monitor's rows as held, not the deduplicated and severity-filtered list the panel below draws, because the pill answers how many and the panel answers which. (6) FadeIn and the Sparkline and ProgressRing barrel re-exports were deleted rather than kept: the Command Center was their last consumer and knip said so.
verification: Gate b5 on the implementation tree by exit code: lint 0 (agent-files, doc-links, derived views, read-only guards, icon-button names, form-control names, design-lint 0 baselined, contrast, coverage floors, eslint, typecheck:tests), tsc 0, jest 0 (485 suites, 4361 tests), canary OK (no stable surface moved), build 0; knip 1 on three exports whose only consumer was the deleted Command Center (FadeIn, and the Sparkline and ProgressRing re-exports), removed, knip 0 on the re-run; Playwright 127 passed, 1 failed, 8 skipped, the failure a read ECONNRESET on the old-paths redirect probe before its first assertion, that spec re-run alone 22 passed. The final commit (bee930f9) was checked by the seven suites it touches (101 tests), eslint on every changed file, typecheck:tests 0 and a fresh production build 0; the full jest suite was re-run on it for this record.
mutation: 36 mutants against the committed tree, 33 killed on the first pass (752a4c2c) and every one of 36 on the second (bee930f9): the hook that never settles, always settles, or swallows either error; a pill that reads Healthy while checking or after a failed check, or prints the raw state word; a gateway pill that links elsewhere; a spend pill that shows zero while loading or reads the week; an errors pill counting the filtered list; a memory pill without its facts; a monitor failure drawn as skeletons; a Retry that does nothing; a checklist that speaks unsettled or waits only for the monitor; a page that hard-codes the model fact; a latch that never latches, keeps the old address, or latches the framework; a model step always done, wrongly linked, or after the mission; a bundle whose active days are fixed at 30 or unclamped; a Progress line without the Quests door, counting every achievement as unlocked, silent on error, naming the kind instead of the automation, or with the badge linked elsewhere; Insights reading active days from the summary, a Retry that forgets the bundle or the timeseries, the cost sub-line back, the mix without Draft, and a timeseries hook whose refetch never touches the wire. The three first-pass survivors were two oracle gaps and one sweep defect: no dashboard test rendered the model step from the facts (added), the timeseries hook was mocked away by the page test (the real hook now runs against a doubled wire), and the sweep's string replace turned the mutant's "$$" into one dollar so the re-added sub-line carried no dollar sign (a function replacer now); the model-fact mutant was also listed against the wrong suites, corrected.
proof: Isolated instance (production build of bee930f9, e2e-b1 data dir, mock-hermes 8747, mock-hindsight 9277), three scenes, 22 checks, all PASS: (1) the board at 1280x720 shows six pills in order reading Healthy, Healthy, Ticking, $0.00, Idle and 0, no clock in the header, no Rec Room card, none of the Command Center's charts, the Progress line with Achievements 4/36, no automation scheduled and a Quests link to /quests, the Spend pill a link to Insights, no skeleton left, and the Subsystems panel in the same words as the pills; (2) with /api/monitor answering 500, an alert says the monitor could not be read with a Retry, no skeleton stays, and no pill reads Healthy; (3) Insights shows the Active days tile for 30d and 7d following the switch, every dollar figure on the page inside the spend panel (six of six), the Mission mix card with its five statuses, and nothing about an estimated cost. Screenshots: scratchpad walk-b5/{board-1280x720,board-monitor-failed,insights-1280x720}.png.
harness_amendments: The oracle suites were written and refuted by a workflow of eight agents before the red was measured; the skeptics caught a clock query that would have stayed red after a faithful header, a next-automation query that required two elements the contract never asked for, a stats mock shape the real hook cannot produce, a monitor failure injected through one wire helper only, and a pill count that would have swallowed a Progress-line label. Afterwards: first-run-steps learned the four steps and the model href; b2-toasts-stack reads the page and the Progress line where it read the Command Center; achievements and progression fixtures were untouched; subsystems-route-and-panel asserts the ratified words; the B5 dashboard oracle lost its s regex flag for the tests tsconfig; and after the sweep the dashboard oracle gained the model-step case, the Insights oracle a real-hook refetch case, and the monitor-failure case was scoped to pills.
deferred: The Quests page the Progress line links to is B17's; the Help section is B16's. The monitor's last-good pills carry no staleness mark when a later poll fails (the alert replaces them only when nothing was ever read). Screenshot recapture for the docs is B18's, with the seeded demo data. The walkthrough's Insights notes still name the old route under Laboratory in one place, rewritten wholesale in B18.
